en.headline: Hong Kong signs protocol giving firms equal treatment across ASEAN
en.dek: The First Protocol to the ASEAN-Hong Kong Investment Agreement activates national treatment and most-favoured-nation provisions for non-services sectors in the 10 member states.
body: Hong Kong and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations signed the First Protocol to Amend the Investment Agreement in Manila on Sunday, enabling Hong Kong enterprises to receive treatment no less favourable than that given to local or foreign firms in the 10 ASEAN member states.

Under Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Bernard Chan signed the protocol alongside Philippine Trade Secretary Ma. Cristina A. Roque and Thailand’s Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun, ahead of the 10th ASEAN Economic Ministers–Hong Kong consultation.

The protocol incorporates schedules of reservations so that Articles 3 and 4 of the Investment Agreement on national treatment and most-favoured-nation treatment can take effect for investments in non-services sectors. The agreement also provides for fair and equitable treatment, physical protection and security of investments, and free transfer of investments and returns.

A Commerce and Economic Development Bureau spokesman said ASEAN has been Hong Kong’s third-largest destination for outward direct investment for four consecutive years, with stock reaching HK$671.2 billion. The government and the 10 ASEAN states will work towards early implementation so that Hong Kong firms can benefit as soon as possible.

zh.headline: 香港簽署東盟投資協定議定書 企業享國民及最惠待遇
zh.dek: 《修訂香港與東盟投資協定的第一議定書》今日在馬尼拉簽署，啓動非服務業領域的國民待遇及最惠待遇條款。
body: 香港與東南亞國家聯盟今日在馬尼拉簽署《修訂香港與東盟投資協定的第一議定書》，使香港企業在東盟十國可享有不低於當地或外國企業的待遇。
商務及經濟發展局副局長陳百里、菲律賓貿易和工業部部長Ma. Cristina A. Roque及泰國副總理兼商務部部長Suphajee Suthumpun共同簽署議定書，其後舉行第十屆中國香港—東盟經貿部長會議。
議定書將保留措施清單納入投資協定，令第三條（國民待遇）及第四條（最惠待遇）生效，適用於非服務業投資。協定亦保障公平公正待遇、投資的實質保護與安全，以及投資及回報的自由轉移。
商務及經濟發展局發言人表示，東盟連續四年成為香港第三大向外直接投資目的地，投資存量達6,712億元。香港與東盟十國將密切合作，盡早落實議定書，讓香港企業盡快受惠。
